verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a Playground for rapidly testing and iterating on prompts (helicone-gh-3, helicone-docs-46), where prompts can be saved with commit history and tags and changes tested instantly (helicone-docs-7, helicone-docs-18). Its prompt system supports variables in system prompts, messages and tool schemas (helicone-docs-44), and the gateway reaches 100+ real models (helicone-docs-3). Missing for 10: explicit docs that variables can be filled in and run inside the Playground itself, explicit docs on picking real models within the Playground, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Playground workflow.
